blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Eastern Samar provincial government and local government units are stepping up preparations for El Niño, with water security, agriculture, public health, and fire prevention among their major concerns. While the province is still assessing potential impacts, officials are already implementing measures as weather forecasts indicate drier conditions in the coming months. One local government taking early action is the municipality of Llorente, where officials are scouting potential watershed areas that could provide additional sources of potable water for the community.
